jobs_results.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs_results.description:
El puesto de Senior Systems Engineer, es una posición de alto nivel dentro del campo de la ingeniería de sistemas. Como ingeniero de sistemas, su función principal es diseñar, desarrollar y mantener sistemas informáticos y de software.

Funciones:
• Planificación y seguimiento de la ejecución de proyectos relacionados con los sistemas CIS.
• Desarrollo, ejecución y supervisión de planes, políticas, prácticas y procedimientos de gestión de proyectos relacionados con las tecnologías de la información.
• Estudio, análisis, valoración y seguimiento de nuevas tendencias de los sistemas CIS, y de la normativa e iniciativa de carácter nacional e internacional.
• Coordinación y supervisión para el desarrollo de actividades técnicas relevantes, en los distintos proyectos en los que se trabaje o colabore.

Requisitos:

Titulación:
• Titulación académica de Máster universitario en Ingeniería Informática o en Telecomunicaciones o equivalente.

Conocimientos:
• Conocimientos en gestión de... proyectos.
• Conocimientos en gestión de servicios de tecnologías de la información
• Conocimientos en seguridad de la información.
• Conocimientos de diseño, configuración y administración de redes.
• Conocimientos en gestión y configuración de MS Windows Server y SQL Server.

Experiencia:
• 8 años de experiencia en dirección y coordinación de proyectos de tecnologías de la información

jobs_results.title: Nologin Consulting SLU: Admin sistemas senior
jobs_results.description:
Nologin Consulting SLU busca un/a Admin sistemas senior

En Nologin realizamos servicios profesionales TI (diseño de arquitecturas, implantaciones, consolidaciones, migraciones y consultorías) sobre diferentes tecnologías de Datacenter, tanto on-premise como en nubes públicas e híbridas. Disponemos de acuerdos y realizamos colaboraciones con los más importantes fabricantes de hardware y software del mercado.

Una de nuestras áreas más importantes son nuestros servicios gestionados WorkOnData/Cloud/Security, en los que nuestros clientes delegan la gestión de sus infraestructuras y procesos en Nologin.

Actualmente estamos en una importante fase de crecimiento en este área y necesitamos incorporar nuevos ingenieros a nuestro equipo.

Qué estamos buscando
• Ingenieros que quieran incorporarse a proyectos de larga duración, arropados por un equipo formado desde hace años y con ganas de aprender nuevas tecnologías
• Experiencia en las tecnologías, con ganas y compromiso, que quieran... aceptar el reto de participar en proyectos internacionales de gran envergadura

Tecnologías utilizadas en el proyecto (ninguno sabemos de todo ésto, aunque trabajamos con todas ellas y muchas más, dinos cuales son tu especialidad ;-)
• Sistemas Operativos: Linux (Redhat/CentOS) - Solaris
• Bases de datos: oracle, mysql, postgresql, mongodb
• Redes (routers, firewalls, soluciones IDS/IPS): dell, cisco, fortinet, paloalto
• Sistemas de virtualización (vmware, redhatVM, hyperV, oracleVM, solaris zones)
• Administración de Sistemas de almacenamiento SAN/NAS y backup
• Aplicaciones internet (Servidores de aplicación, JVM, Web, LDAP, DNS, ...)
• Scripting y automatización: bash, python, perl, powershell - ansible,jenkins, rundeck
• Contenedores : dockers, kubernetes

Experiencia profesional

Se requiere una experiencia mínima de 3 años en puesto similar, aunque si puedes demostrar conocimientos altos en las tecnologías anteriores, valoraremos tu candidatura

Valorable positivamente:
• Formación en ingeniería informática o de telecomunicaciones
• Certificaciones ITIL o relacionadas con las tecnologías mencionadas

Qué ofrecemos
• Trabajar para una empresa en la que valoramos el dinamismo, la flexibilidad, el trabajo en equipo, ser proactivos y claramente técnicos. Hablamos tu mismo idioma desde el CEO al último empleado que haya entrado con nosotros
• Incorporación inmediata a un equipo de trabajo ya formado con altos conocimientos tecnológicos
• Proyecto internacional para un cliente en USA, puntero tanto en la tecnología utilizada como en el nivel de los mismos. No trabajamos para pequeña empresa.
• Grandes posibilidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo profesional en el sector de las tecnologías de la información.
• Trabajar con las últimas tecnologías y numerosos fabricantes, diversificando tu formación.
• Paquete completo de Beneficios sociales y retribución flexible: seguro salud, guardería, parking, actividades deportivas y mucho mucho más

jobs_results.title: Senior Mechanical System Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Ready to be part of a dynamic team that's revolutionizing the 3D printing industry? Imagine a work environment where your every contribution creates a ripple effect of innovation. If you're drawn to challenges, seek out the thrill of cutting-edge projects, and thrive in a culture of autonomy, trust, and ownership, then this is more than just a job – it’s a passion-fueled journey.

At Supernova, we’re not just innovators; we’re game-changers. We aim to produce end-use parts at scale and cost by developing a complete industrial solution to unlock the power and benefits of Additive Manufacturing. We are 100% customer-centered and aware that the value we are bringing is the ability to produce fully functional parts. We work with the conviction that excellence in science and engineering is the cornerstone of transformative change. In our relentless pursuit of excellence, we adopt a champion’s mindset, we take controlled risks, and we are constantly on offense to get things done.

Your... mission

As a Senior System Mechanical Engineer at Supernova, you will be at the heart of our hardware innovation, focusing on the design and manufacturing of our advanced 3D printing systems. Your role involves leading the design and integration of hardware subsystems, bringing your expertise in CAD, mechanism design, package integration, component fabrication, and assembly processes. This position demands a unique combination of mechanical excellence and intuitive design skills. You will be hands-on and meticulous, responsible for overseeing the transition from conceptual design to serialized production of our cutting-edge ecosystem. Your leadership will be instrumental in realizing complex designs and turning them into manufacturable and functional products. We’re looking for a proactive engineer who embodies our ‘get things done’ ethos and has the talent to materialize concepts into tangible innovations.

Key responsibilities:
• Lead the mechanical subsystems design.
• Lead the multiple mechatronics subsystems integration.
• Define prototyping strategies and testing protocols.
• Ensure manufacturability of designs and leading industrialization of prototypes.
• Engage in hands-on R&D for characterizing complex industrial printing processes.
• Participate in the IP generation of complex AM processes.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (from Software to Materials), ensuring a ‘we’re all in the same boat’ approach to project execution.
• Embrace a ‘Champion’s mindset’ to explore innovative ideas, taking controlled risks and seeking opportunities for growth.

About You
• Master’s degree or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in mechanical design, with a focus on design for manufacturability.
• Solid experience in machine design for serialized production.
• Ability and autonomy to assemble prototypes and to use manual tools.
• Ability in CAD and Simulation tools.
• Proven record of accomplishment of taking part in complex engineering projects.

Why Supernova?

Innovate at the Forefront: Drive innovation in 3D printing, shaping the future of the next generation of AM industrial solutions.

Creative & Analytical Synergy: Thrive in an environment where creative problem-solving meets analytical rigor, making a real impact in our pioneering projects.

Growth & Learning: Enjoy continuous professional development at the edge where engineering, science and man manufacturing meet.

Ownership & Accountability: Take ownership of your role and tasks, ensuring accountability in every aspect of your work to make a tangible impact.

Benefits

📚 Continuous Training with Elite Team: Elevate your skills with ongoing training with a high-caliber team, staying at the forefront of innovation and growth.

🌆 Brand-new offices in Barcelona and Austin: Step into our creative, collaborative space filled with light and top-notch service

💚 Well-being Culture: We value flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance and create an atmosphere with no bureaucracy and no bullshit.

🌟 Attractive Salary: Stability meets recognition – a permanent contract paired with a rewarding salary package tailored to your expertise

jobs_results.title: Ground Segment Senior System Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Are you looking for an innovative and consolidated place for your professional development? GMV is an experienced technology group

We are expanding our teams in satellite navigation to work in Galileo project

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website.

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

In our team you will participate in the following activities:
• Ground segment design (including logical and physical architectures)
• Requirements management
• Generation and maintenance of engineering documentation (Design,interfaces, plans, requirements, technical notes...)
• Technical studies execution
• Technical support for other GCS teams (subcontractors, cybersecurity, integration and deployment…)
• Interaction with client (ESA) and subcontractors (within Europe)

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

We are looking for experts in Space system engineering with background and interest in:
• Model-based methodologies (MBSE)
•... Experience in Linux-based systems
• Experience in software development
• Experience in human-machine interfaces development
• Experience in valuable supporting technologies (e.g. python, excel)
• Other relevant IT knowledge (hardware, networks, etc.)
• Fluent in English

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Azahara Marcos Miguel, in charge of this vacancy.

Azahara Marcos Miguel

jobs_results.title: Senior System Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Senior Systems Engineer to join our team at ATOS. As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for leading the implementation and development of projects within datacenter, server, and storage technologies for our clients. You will work closely with our customers to understand their needs, propose solutions, and ensure successful project delivery within established timelines and budgets.

Responsibilities:
• Implement and develop projects within datacenter, server, and storage technologies for clients, ensuring adherence to project timelines and budgets.
• Conduct pre-sale activities, including solution design, proposal development, and customer presentations.
• Prepare reports and provide consulting services in datacenter environments, offering expert advice and recommendations.
• Collaborate with team members and customers to identify opportunities for technology improvement and innovation.
• Continuously update knowledge and... skills in relevant technologies and obtain certifications from manufacturers as required.

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, Telematics, or related field.
• Strong knowledge and experience in datacenter, server, and storage technologies, including virtualization solutions (VMware, Citrix, Microsoft), and datacenter solutions (Dell, Cisco, HP).
• Experience with storage and backup solutions from manufacturers such as Dell, NetApp, Hitachi, Huawei, Veeam, and Commvault.
• Certifications from relevant manufacturers and project management certifications (PMO, ITIL, etc.) are highly valued.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with customers and team members.
• Proficiency in English is required.
• Willingness to complete training and obtain certifications in new technologies as needed.

Beneficios:
• Permanent contract
• Hybrid mode work
• Attractive salary package
• Extensive training and development opportunities at Atos

jobs_results.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Corporate)
jobs_results.description:
Category

SYSTEMS ENGINEERING

Job Location

Carrer dels Traginers, 14 Oficina 12B, Valencia, Valencia / València (ca)

Tracking Code

1571

Position Type

Full-Time/Regular

Casa Systems, Inc. (Nasdaq: CASA) is a next-gen technology leader that supports mobile, cable, and wireline communications services providers with market leading solutions. Casa Systems’ virtualized and cloud-native software solutions modernize operators’ network architectures, expand the range of services they can offer their consumer and commercial customers, accelerate time to revenue, and reduce the TCO of their network infrastructure and operations. Casa Systems’ suite of open, cloud-native network solutions unlocks new ways for service providers to quickly build flexible networks and service offerings that maximize revenue generating capabilities. Commercially deployed in more than 70 countries, Casa Systems serves over 475 Tier 1 and regional service providers worldwide.

The Corporate Senior Systems... Engineer will have significant impact as the technical voice of our customer ensuring the pre-sales development end of our product lifecycle management process and customer requirements are developed and road mapped in Casa Systems’ products involving 4G/5G packet core cloud solutions. The role includes supporting product integration, demonstrations, POCs, and third party IOT’s for Casa’s containerized 4G/5G access and core network products.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Subject matter expert in the area of cloud and virtualization infrastructure, mobile solution integration and deployment.
• Partner with the sales and field teams to drive orders by providing innovative network solutions for new business.
• Obtain customer requirements and translates these into a (customer specific) solution design and/or Casa offer.
• Support and drive lab testing for new business opportunities.
• Validate, integrate and deploy third party products/tools for Casa product solutions and deployment.
• Able and willing to perform lab integration and trials along with presales activities.
• Create and develop technical white papers, MOPs, and ATPs.
• Design, build and maintain cloud and virtualization infrastructure.
• Validate and document CI/CD infrastructure and MOP for product release build, validation and deployment.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Telecommunication.
• 7+ to 10 years of relevant experience in network engineering or support environment. Advanced degree strongly preferred.
• Experience and technical knowledge with 3GPP GPRS/UMTS/LTE/5G core network architectures.
• Advanced IP internetworking and Linux knowledge.
• Experience with containerized and virtualized application deployment.
• Experience with Kubernetes, AWS cloud, Google cloud, Rancher, OpenShift and OpenStack.
• Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture.
• Able to quickly learn new technologies, as required.
• Able to work in a team oriented, fast-paced environment.
• Creative and self-motivated.
• Excellent problem solving, troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
• Able to pass background check and drug testing.
• Able to live Casa’s core values: fun work environment, innovation & risk taking; passion, dedication & perseverance; and honesty & loyalty.

Casa Systems, Inc. offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive benefits and compensation package. Casa Systems, Inc. participates in the E‑Verify program. Casa Systems is committed to fostering a diverse workforce and inclusive work environment free from unlawful employment discrimination and without barriers to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO

jobs_results.title: (Senior) System Engineer - IT Asset Management (m/f/d)
jobs_results.description:
Your Tasks
• Implement business / product team requirements / use cases and processes in ServiceNow
• Improve discovery solution & data to enrich asset information
• Identifies improvement opportunities spanning service delivery, user experience, security, etc.

Your Profile
• Expert & certified in ServiceNow solution (ITAM / ITOM)
• Expert / certified in cloud technologies, including virtualization, networking, identity, storage, backups, resilience, and disaster recovery
• Deep knowledge and practical experience in the conception, integration and operation of applications
• Advanced knowledge in data models
• Advanced skills in Java/ Groovy and bash scripting
• Experienced working in an agile organization (familiar with SCRUM/Kanban and tools like JIRA/Confluence)
• Readiness for independent and team-oriented work
• Self-organized and analytical way of working
• Good English skills in wording and written

About Us

MediaMarktSaturn Technology is working to make Europe’s number-one... consumer electronics retailer the technology leader in its industry. To this end, several hundred developers, UX designers and system architects using state-of-the-art technology work hand in hand with business owners in agile teams to develop customer-focused technology solutions for more than 6 million customers every day in 13 countries.

The Asset Management team is responsible for designing, developing and operate technology to provide services all around asset management throughout the company. Join us if you want the opportunity to actively shape the way asset management will be introduced and worked with to make an impact for the entire company.

Additional Benefits
• Young environment, where not everything is written in stone, and where you are expected to contribute and co-create the culture of the Tech Hub and international collaboration model
• You'll have a 10% discount on the entire MediaMarkt website, so you can treat yourself at a lower price whenever you want!
• On top of your compensation package, you can request Flexible Pay “MediaFlex program” (a.e. Ticket Restaurant, Private Health Insurance with DKV, …)
• Flexible working time and possibility to combine home office / presential working. Intensive workday every Friday and during summer
• The possibility to choose between 2 offices: The first one is the MediaMarkt Iberia HQ with a very attractive menu at a price. You'll eat for less than €4! And the second office is located at Pier01, in Barceloneta, right in the center of Barcelona. Free coffee and free fruit once a week
• If you need a VISA, don't worry, we'll assist you with the visa process and accompany you throughout the entire process!
• There is a training budget so you can continue developing the skills you need most to keep growing professionally and personally!
• We offer language classes: English, Spanish, and German
• On your birthday, you won't work! It's a day for you to enjoy without thinking about work
• You'll be working with the most cutting-edge technological stack of the moment

jobs_results.title: Senior Frontend & Design System Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Get to know us

Do you want to help us shape what the future of work will look like and how it will best embrace our life's aspirations? If this sounds like a journey you want to embark on, we may have the right role for you!

PayFit is an intuitive cloud-based payroll and employee management solution designed specifically for SMBs. Since 2015, we have set ourselves a mission to simplify payroll for SMBs and enable employers and employees to grow together. We are a European company operating from 3 main countries (France, Spain, and the UK) where we are supporting over 10,000 clients.

Creating a Fulfilling Work Environment And Culture Is Also a Core Mission At PayFit, And Our Day-to-day Work Philosophy Is Reflected In Our Four Values

Care

We genuinely care for others whoever they are, whatever they think.

Excellence

We aim to improve and achieve better results every day.

Humility

Staying humble and exchanging transparent feedback helps us to grow and improve.

Passion

We are... the architects of PayFit's success.

A key part of our culture, and essential for our success, is also improving the diversity of our teams and building an inclusive culture where you can be yourself at work.

This is why our recruitment focuses on the skills you demonstrate, and not only on your academic background or previous professional experiences. At PayFit we understand that you can gain applicable skills through a variety of life experiences and we are interested in knowing them, too.

About The Role

We are on the lookout for a talented and seasoned Senior Frontend Application and Design System Engineer to become an integral part of our 'Frontend Framework' team. This role is pivotal in sculpting the future of our frontend landscape. You will play a key role in the evolution and expansion of our design system, alongside championing best practices to support a dynamic team of 100-200 engineers. This position offers the opportunity to exert significant influence and ownership over these processes.

Responsibilities

Assume a pivotal role in the creation of our next-generation design system, demonstrating robust ownership to facilitate a transition to a scalable and maintainable architecture. This design system will be intricately crafted to cater to both the company's objectives and the engineering team's requirements.
• Engage in collaborative efforts with interdisciplinary teams, including backend developers, UI/UX designers, and product managers, to guarantee a cohesive integration and an exceptional user experience.
• Develop, document, and sustain components in adherence to established standards.
• Enhance the synergy between designers and developers by implementing automated solutions.
• Establish and uphold front-end architectural standards, best practices, and design patterns across the engineering organization. Tackle complex technical debt to boost system maintainability and performance.
• Mentor and guide engineers in advancing their front-end expertise, nurturing a culture of ongoing learning and development.
• Spearhead the creation of essential front-end tools and components, augmenting application performance, modularity, and maintainability.
• Collaborate intimately with product managers to comprehend user requirements and convert them into effective front-end solutions that elevate user satisfaction.
• Lead discussions on Front End technical strategies and decisions, ensuring they are in sync with business objectives and scalability demands.
• Promote the establishment of robust front-end conventions within an event-driven architecture framework, advocating best practices in event management and communication.
• Operate effectively within a design system context, maintaining consistency and usability in the user interface.
• Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to continually advance our front-end application in a transformative landscape.

This Role Is For You If You Have
• Proven experience (5+ years) as a Senior Front End Application Engineer or similar role in complex web applications.
• Strong expertise with JavaScript/ES6, Typescript, React and its ecosystems
• Expertise with bundling tools such as webpack, Vite, rollup
• Experience with building, distributing and maintaining Javascript libraries (npm modules)
• Experience working with complex frontend architecture such as micro frontends
• Experience in building a Design System, and ensuring consistency and adherence to established design principles
• Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor technical teams, fostering skill growth and collaboration. Exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

It Would Be Great If You Also
• Have Previous experience in SaaS or enterprise-level application development
• Have excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating complex technical debt.
• Have demonstrated the ability to make trade-offs for incremental progress while driving transformation initiatives.

Hiring process
• First you will meet a Talent Acquisition Specialist for a discovery call (45 min)
• Next step will be a meeting with Gaël & Rafa, Product Manager & Designer (60 min)
• You will go through a frontend technical interview with Nicolas & Cyril, Staff Engineers (60 min)
• Then you will have a System Design live discussion with Stephen , Staff Engineer (45 min)
• The last step would be having a discussion with Pierre, Engineering Director (30 min)

What We Offer

Flexibility: We believe it is key to produce your best work and to be fulfilled. We therefore offer the possibility to work away from our main offices, within France/UK/Spain; as well as abroad for a defined period of time. Further requirements may apply depending on the role and your overall experience.

Learning & Development: In PayFit we have a great learning platform where you can learn new skills everyday with the support of our company. We also have English language courses to improve your business communication vocabulary and get to the next level.

Career Development: We want you to progress and be free to choose which direction you want to grow. There are also opportunities for internal moves.

Health promotion: Gym membership conditions depending on country and 4 paid sessions with a mental health practitioner and online support with Moka Care.

Health insurance: with conditions depending on the country.

Meals: Restaurant tickets.

Home office budget: To help you get set up in the best conditions. A MacBook as our standard working tool.

Disability Inclusion: All of our positions are open to any person living with a disability. To guarantee equal treatment and opportunities, we will take, based on individual needs, appropriate measures to adapt the work conditions of PayFiters with disabilities, and if needed also during the recruitment process. Please let us know what you need and we will do our best to accommodate

jobs_results.title: Senior Safety Engineer
jobs_results.description:
En Expleo Iberia, como Consultora de Ingeniería y Tecnología, brindamos experiencia técnica avanzada en múltiples industrias a numerosos clientes, líderes en mercado. Ubicados en España desde hace 20 años, tenemos oficinas en las principales ciudades de la península. Contamos con el talento de más de 350 empleados a nivel local y más de 19000 empleados en todo el mundo, dando los mejores servicios de consultoría de ingeniería, calidad y gestión a lo largo de todo el ciclo de vida del producto, desde las fases de I+D y diseño conceptual hasta la puesta en marcha.

Estamos buscando un/a Ingenier@ de Safety con experiencia en CBTC para equipos embarcados para trabajar con nosotros en proyectos ferroviarios .

Responsibilities

Las principaples responabilidades del puesto son las siguientes:
• Elaboración de estudios y documentación de Seguridad a lo largo del ciclo de vida de la aplicación específica: Planes de Seguridad/V&V, Análisis Preliminar de Amenazas, Gestión de SRACs de... genéricos, Hazard Log (seguimiento de amenazas, medidas de mitigación, condiciones de uso/aplicación y riesgos exportados), Análisis de Seguridad de Interfaces, Informes de Verificación, Validación y Safety Case de Aplicación Específica.
• Revisión de Documentación de Diseño (Definición/arquitectura del sistema, Especificación de Pruebas y Requisitos, Documentación de Productos genéricos, Programación de Datos, Informes de No Regresión en modificaciones del sistema), Validación (Protocolos de Pruebas de Validación) e Instalación (Puntos de inspección y Hojas de Registro de Grabación).
• Análisis de fallos en las interfaces (IFFA)
• Informes de verificación de cumplimiento de la normativa CENELEC 5012X
• Seguimiento de actividades de seguridad de aplicaciones específicas de CBTC en las líneas de Metro.
• Casos de seguridad genérico y específico, de equipos embarcados,

Qualifications

Se requiere formación en Ingeneria (Grado o Máster Industrial) preferentemente de ámbito electrónico,industrial, de las Telecomunicaciones o Aeroespacial.

Inglés B2 o Nivel suficiente para trabajar de forma autónoma en inglés (los proyectos son internacionales).

Skills
• Conocimientos de Equipos Embarcados (ATO, ATO, DMI, Eurocabinas)
• Manejo del paquete MS OFFICE.
• Normativa CENELEC (EN50126, EN50128, EN50129)
• Nivel alto de Inglés (B2)

Desired Skills
• Habilidades de comunicación y calidad en la redacción de la documentación.
• Rigurosidad y espíritu crítico.

Experience

Al menos de 4 años en seguridad y/o señalización ferroviaria de RAMS de Mass Transit (ATO, ATO, DMI, Eurocabinas).

Benefits

Trabajar en un entorno de trabajo colaborativo. Trabajamos codo con codo entre los compañeros y los clientes internos, en los buenos momentos y en los desafíos.

Potenciamos a todos los profesionales apasionados por la tecnología permitiéndoles ampliar sus habilidades y participar en proyectos inspiradores.

Formación técnica, de idiomas y de habilidades.

Salario competitivo en función de la experiencia aportada. Beneficios competitivos de la empresa, como plan de compensación flexible, beneficios sociales, etc.

24 días de vacaciones anuales más el 24 y 31 de diciembre.

Trabajando siempre en equipo, nuestra gente no tiene miedo de pensar en grande y desafiar el status quo.

Interacción con un equipo experimentado y técnicamente capaz.
